description: Use when you need ENS on Ethereum: name to address (name=vitalik.eth, via the Universal Resolver, with resolver address) or address to primary name (address=0x..., reverse record, forward-verified). Returns the exact paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/ens, $0.002 per call), with the response schema and an example; call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge.
